children.value: > Fact From Story: Google's technologies, like "Featured Snippets," shift traffic away from publishers' websites.
> > Fact From Story: Google drives nearly 40% of publishers' traffic.
> > > Fact From Story: Some publishers believe they’ll lose somewhere between 20-40% of their website traffic when Google’s AI products fully roll out.

> > > Fact From Story: When online magazine The Atlantic modeled what would happen if Google integrated AI into search, it found that 75% of the time the AI would answer the user’s query without requiring a click-through to its website, losing it traffic.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Losing a large amount of traffic will necessarily reduce revenue.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A significant decrease in website traffic can substantially impact a business that relies on online presence.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Shifting traffic away from publishers' websites can negatively impact their revenue.
